description: This PHP source file contains functions related to displaying and managing calendar activities, specifically for retrieving pending/upcoming activities and generating activity view selection HTML in a CRM system.

classes.name: DateTimeField
classes.description: A class used for handling date and time formatting and conversions.

methods.name: getPendingActivities
methods.description: Retrieves pending or upcoming activities based on mode and view, returning an array with activity details and HTML entries.

methods.name: getActivityview
methods.description: Generates HTML for a dropdown selection box to choose different activity views (Today, This Week, This Month, This Year).
